Compute \( r^{2} \):
\[
r^{2}= \left(\frac{-21-\sqrt{301}}{10}\right)^{2}= \frac{(-21-\sqrt{301})^{2}}{100}
          = \frac{441+2\cdot21\cdot\sqrt{301}+301}{100}
          = \frac{742+42\sqrt{301}}{100}.
\]
Multiply by 5:
\[
5r^{2}=5\left(\frac{742+42\sqrt{301}}{100}\right)
      =\frac{3710+210\sqrt{301}}{100}
      =\frac{371}{10}+\frac{21}{10}\sqrt{301}.
\]
Now substitute \( r \) and \( r^{2} \) into the equation:
\[
5r^{2}+21r+v = \left(\frac{371}{10}+\frac{21}{10}\sqrt{301}\right)
                  +21\left(\frac{-21-\sqrt{301}}{10}\right)+v.
\]
Simplify the linear term:
\[
21\left(\frac{-21-\sqrt{301}}{10}\right)=\frac{-441-21\sqrt{301}}{10}
      =-\frac{441}{10}-\frac{21}{10}\sqrt{301}.

\[

= \frac{371-441}{10}+v
= -\frac{70}{10}+v
= -7 + v.
